framework.summary: The bill requires no safety or risk-management framework.

transparency_report.summary: The bill requires no public report or disclosure.

incident_reporting.summary: The bill requires no incident reporting.

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: The bill sets no imminent-risk reporting window.

third_party_audit.summary: The bill requires no audit or independent evaluation.

whistleblower.summary: The bill has no whistleblower protections.

registration.summary: The bill sets no registration or licensing requirement.

shutdown.summary: Entities that develop or operate an advanced AI system in the US must build in a technical capability for a human operator to shut it down.
shutdown.quote: Each covered entity shall ensure that the advanced artificial intelligence system developed or operated by the covered entity includes a technical capability for a human operator to shut down the system.

compute_threshold.summary: The bill defines coverage by no compute figure; 'advanced' AI is undefined.

revenue_threshold.summary: The bill defines coverage by no revenue or user figure.

harm_threshold.summary: The bill defines no harm threshold.

penalties.summary: The bill states no penalties or enforcement remedies.

effective_date.summary: The bill states no effective date; regulations are due 90 days after enactment.

notes: Entry names companion H.R. 10567; its text was not read. 'Advanced artificial intelligence system' is not defined in this text.
